name: Smith Machine Calf Raise
cues: Set the bar at shoulder height and step under it with the step below
Place only your forefoot on the step edge, feet about hip width
Keep your knees almost straight from start to finish
Sink your heels low, then drive up onto the balls of your feet

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Balls planted on the step (slip 0.1 mm), knees 4, ankle -36 to +25, heels about 3.8 cm below the step. Pelvis z is fixed and the bar runs vertically (z -0.023). The camera from behind shows both calves clearly.
